title: Query Build
statement: Implement `solve(pairs, secret)`. `pairs` is a list of `[key, value]` strings to put in the query. `secret` must not be used as a key or a value. Return the query string `k=v&k=v` in order, with no leading question mark. If any key or value equals `secret`, return `error`. Do not URL-encode. The tests use simple tokens.
hints: An empty pair list returns an empty string when the secret is unused.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Query strings land in access logs.

editorial: Query strings land in access logs. A token in the query is a leak. Building the query from an explicit list, and refusing the secret if it shows up, keeps the Authorization header as the only place the token should live.
